verdict.rationale: Mintlify's own agent researches, plans, and writes docs, then opens pull requests for review. It can run from a prompt in the editor or Slack, and automations run it on a schedule, on repository pushes, or on integration events. However, triggering on a PR specifically and the agent reviewing PRs are not explicitly documented; repository pushes and in-editor comments/suggestions are the closest evidence. Missing for 10: an explicit PR-opened trigger for the agent, documented agent review of incoming PRs, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the agent's change-request workflow.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, a platform AI agent drafts, updates, and reviews my docs — from a prompt, a PR, or a schedule — and ships its work as change requests

citations.quote: Learn how the Mintlify agent researches, plans, and writes documentation, then opens pull requests with proposed changes for your team to review.
